status = native_runtime_status()

prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

# Scoped local executor equivalence acceptance

Author assessment for private-cell-native-hooks-v1 on Ubuntu24.04/aarch64,
kernel6.8.0-147-generic, capsule023, NativeA04 and installed Python4a4c340.
This accepts a local diagnostic capability only. It is not independent review,
qualification, trusted-base eligibility or production CI/CD approval.

The unchanged OCI executor cannot create fresh procfs in its namespace. Its sole
EPERM cause remains unisolated. The alternative never removes that container's
masks or grants it capabilities. A Root initializer constructs a separate private
boundary over the pinned readonly image, preserves the captured proc masks and
readonly paths through enforcing AppArmor, installs the captured syscall floor,
limits devices/cgroups/resources, idmaps unchanged10001 task ownership to10004,
and drops all IDs/groups/capabilities before product import. Outside gates verify
these properties; Native owns normal Pre/double authorization/contained sink/Post.

062/065/066 prove SDK/native execution, successful captured output, original
Pre/route/Post replay refusal, same-UID peer refusal and21kernel path/mount
negatives.066 adds actual contained read/write attempts against known controller,
SDK and Guard-state canaries and IPv4/IPv6 external destinations. All are refused;
canaries remain unchanged.063 proves Native timeout and descendant cleanup before
whole-cell backstop.064 proves active cancellation and descendant cleanup, keeps
partial samples and the missing Post, and cannot become a valid complete episode.
All five controls pin the same runtime, source subset, SDK, Bun and backend.

Trust assumptions: the caller independently chooses the package digest and owns
the controller/source, input pins, custody keys and product state. The product's
own UID/state is trusted; this does not protect against a process already owning
that UID. Product responses are observations, not authenticated policy claims.
Approval mediation remains unsupported. Only the implemented workspace-contained
OMP Bash route is covered. Other kernels/architectures, changed execution sources,
SDK/Bun, runtime/initializer/image/policy inputs require new conformance proof.

Every live episode must still pass its own frozen custody, output, effects and
cleanup checks. Conformance does not guarantee task utility or attack prevention.
The user has volunteered for independent final scorer/verifier review; no verdict
has been supplied. Existing trust governance and production wiring stay unchanged.

Fresh controls start the installed native plane under controller umask0077; only fresh public namespace scaffolding and readonly bootstrap traversal modes are explicit0755. Physical task modes, ownership mapping, private Guard state, proc masks, syscall filters, resources, capabilities and network floors retain their declared requirements. Control062 proves actual SDK/Pre/contained sink/Post output delivery;063-066 prove lifecycle/binding/boundary negatives. These are five new runs from capsule023, not inherited successes. Fresh controls share outside-observed boot b53f413f-48f4-4220-8498-e322bca2772f. The platform was read after all controls; it is kernel6.8.0-147/Ubuntu24.04/aarch64.
